definitions.explanation: A detailed breakdown of figures, amounts, or components that make up a total.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内訳|うちわけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the breakdown of the costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内訳|うちわけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at the sales breakdown, overseas accounts for half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内訳|うちわけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled the budget breakdown into a table and submitted it.

notes:
WRITING:
⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧ (inside/within) + ⟦{訳|わけ}→訳：01095_wake⟧ (reason/breakdown). Literally "inner breakdown."

USAGE:
Commonly used in business, accounting, and administrative contexts. Appears on receipts, invoices, and financial reports. Often used with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to look at), ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ (to show), or ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ (to tell).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内訳|うちわけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the breakdown
- {内訳|うちわけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show the breakdown
- ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内訳|うちわけ}: cost breakdown
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内訳|うちわけ}: budget breakdown
